summary: Poppy Playtime entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Poppy Playtime
entries.definitive_edition: Current Steam PC release with exact chapter/DLC state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC build with exact chapter/DLC/build state documented

primary.version: Current Steam PC release with chapter/DLC state documented
primary.why: Poppy Playtime is episodic, with free Chapter 1 and later paid chapters; the current PC route is the best capture baseline. Console/mobile ports and Project: Playtime are separate platform/spin-off routes.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Steam PC release with intended chapters installed. Record build, chapter, DLC ownership, graphics settings, input, subtitles/language, collectibles/VHS/lore state, performance/bugs, and whether console/mobile ports were compared.

secondary.why: PC is the clearest capture route.
It is not the episodic single-player game.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not merge with Project: Playtime or later spin-offs.
